mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "totalRevenue", COUNT(*) AS "totalReservations", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS "completedReservations", COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN total_price END), 0)::bigint AS "averageTransactionAmount", ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1 ) AS "completionRate", COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(total_spent)::bigint FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND total_spent > 0), 0 ) AS "customerLTV", COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN total_duration END), 0)::integer AS "averageServiceDuration" FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT
TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date",
TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('week', reservation_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date",
TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS "date",
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "revenue", COUNT(*) AS "reservationCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS "completedCount" FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY
TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('week', reservation_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY "date" ASC

WITH service_data AS ( SELECT (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'id')::bigint AS service_id, jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'name' AS service_name, (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'price')::integer AS service_price FROM reservations r WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.services IS NOT NULL ), total AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(service_price), 1) AS total_revenue FROM service_data ) SELECT sd.service_id AS "serviceId", sd.service_name AS "serviceName", sc.name AS "categoryName", COALESCE(SUM(sd.service_price), 0) AS "revenue", ROUND(SUM(sd.service_price) * 100.0 / t.total_revenue, 1) AS "percentage", COUNT(*) AS "reservationCount" FROM service_data sd LEFT JOIN services s ON sd.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_categories sc ON s.category_id = sc.id CROSS JOIN total t GROUP BY sd.service_id, sd.service_name, sc.name, t.total_revenue ORDER BY "revenue" DESC LIMIT 10

WITH total AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 1) AS total_revenue FROM customer_histories WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) SELECT ch.payment_method AS "method", CASE ch.payment_method WHEN 'CARD' THEN '카드' WHEN 'CASH' THEN '현금' WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN '계좌이체' ELSE '기타' END AS "methodName", COALESCE(SUM(ch.total_price), 0) AS "revenue", ROUND(SUM(ch.total_price) * 100.0 / t.total_revenue, 1) AS "percentage", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM customer_histories ch CROSS JOIN total t WHERE ch.business_id = #{businessId} AND ch.visit_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ch.payment_method, t.total_revenue ORDER BY "revenue" DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalReservations", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS "completedReservations", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS "cancelledReservations", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'NO_SHOW' THEN 1 END) AS "noShowReservations", COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') THEN 1 END) AS "pendingReservations", ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1 ) AS "completionRate", ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1 ) AS "cancellationRate", ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'NO_SHOW' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1 ) AS "noShowRate", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW') THEN total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "lostRevenue" FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT
TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date",
TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('week', reservation_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date",
TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS "date",
COUNT(*) AS "total", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS "completed", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS "cancelled", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'NO_SHOW' THEN 1 END) AS "noShow", COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') THEN 1 END) AS "pending" FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY
TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('week', reservation_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY "date" ASC

SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM reservation_date)::integer AS "dayOfWeek", EXTRACT(HOUR FROM start_time)::integer AS "hour", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM reservation_date), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM start_time) ORDER BY "dayOfWeek", "hour"

WITH total AS ( SELECT NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS total_count FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) SELECT r.status AS "status", CASE r.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '대기' WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN '확정' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '완료' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '취소' WHEN 'NO_SHOW' THEN '노쇼' ELSE r.status END AS "statusName", COUNT(*) AS "count", ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / t.total_count, 1) AS "percentage" FROM reservations r CROSS JOIN total t WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY r.status, t.total_count ORDER BY "count" DESC

WITH daily_counts AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM reservation_date)::integer AS day_of_week, reservation_date, COUNT(*) AS day_count FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM reservation_date), reservation_date ) SELECT day_of_week AS "dayOfWeek", CASE day_of_week WHEN 1 THEN '월' WHEN 2 THEN '화' WHEN 3 THEN '수' WHEN 4 THEN '목' WHEN 5 THEN '금' WHEN 6 THEN '토' WHEN 7 THEN '일' END AS "dayName", ROUND(AVG(day_count), 1) AS "averageCount", SUM(day_count)::integer AS "totalCount" FROM daily_counts GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId}) AS "totalCustomers", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND created_at >= #{startDate}::date AND created_at < (#{endDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') ) AS "newCustomers", ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count >= 2) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId}), 0), 1 ) AS "returningRate", COALESCE( (SELECT ROUND(AVG(visit_count), 1) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count > 0), 0 ) AS "averageVisitCount", COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(total_spent)::bigint FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND total_spent > 0), 0 ) AS "averageLTV", ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count > 0 AND last_visit_date < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') ) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count > 0), 0), 1 ) AS "churnRate"

WITH months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(generate_series( DATE_TRUNC('month', #{startDate}::date), DATE_TRUNC('month', #{endDate}::date), '1 month' ), 'YYYY-MM') AS month ), new_customers AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND created_at >= #{startDate}::date AND created_at < (#{endDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') ), returning_customers AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(r.reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS cnt FROM reservations r JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CONFIRMED', 'PENDING') AND c.visit_count >= 2 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(r.reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') ), active_customers AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS cnt FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CONFIRMED', 'PENDING') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') ), churned_customers AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(gs, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count > 0 AND last_visit_date < (DATE_TRUNC('month', gs) - INTERVAL '3 months') ) AS cnt FROM generate_series( DATE_TRUNC('month', #{startDate}::date), DATE_TRUNC('month', #{endDate}::date), '1 month' ) AS gs ) SELECT m.month AS "date", COALESCE(nc.cnt, 0) AS "newCustomers", COALESCE(rc.cnt, 0) AS "returningCustomers", COALESCE(ac.cnt, 0) AS "totalActive", COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS "churned" FROM months m LEFT JOIN new_customers nc ON m.month = nc.month LEFT JOIN returning_customers rc ON m.month = rc.month LEFT JOIN active_customers ac ON m.month = ac.month LEFT JOIN churned_customers cc ON m.month = cc.month ORDER BY m.month ASC

WITH total AS ( SELECT NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS total_count FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} ), segments AS ( SELECT 'VIP' AS segment, 'VIP 고객' AS segment_name, '10회 이상 방문' AS description, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(total_spent), 0) AS total_revenue FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count >= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'REGULAR', '단골 고객', '3~9회 방문', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(total_spent), 0) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count BETWEEN 3 AND 9 UNION ALL SELECT 'NEW', '신규 고객', '1~2회 방문', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(total_spent), 0) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'INACTIVE', '휴면 고객', '3개월 이상 미방문', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(total_spent), 0) FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND visit_count > 0 AND last_visit_date < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') ) SELECT s.segment AS "segment", s.segment_name AS "segmentName", s.description AS "description", s.cnt AS "count", ROUND(s.cnt * 100.0 / t.total_count, 1) AS "percentage", s.total_revenue AS "totalRevenue", CASE WHEN s.cnt > 0 THEN (s.total_revenue / s.cnt) ELSE 0 END AS "averageRevenue" FROM segments s CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY CASE s.segment WHEN 'VIP' THEN 1 WHEN 'REGULAR' THEN 2 WHEN 'NEW' THEN 3 WHEN 'INACTIVE' THEN 4 END

WITH monthly_data AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(r.reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.visit_count >= 2 THEN r.customer_id END) AS returning_customers FROM reservations r JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CONFIRMED', 'PENDING') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(r.reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') ) SELECT month AS "date", ROUND(returning_customers * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_customers, 0), 1) AS "rate" FROM monthly_data ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT r.range_label AS "range", r.min_val AS "min", r.max_val AS "max", COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS "count" FROM ( VALUES ('0~5만', 0, 50000, 1), ('5~10만', 50000, 100000, 2), ('10~30만', 100000, 300000, 3), ('30~50만', 300000, 500000, 4), ('50~100만', 500000, 1000000, 5), ('100만 이상', 1000000, 999999999, 6) ) AS r(range_label, min_val, max_val, sort_order) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN total_spent < 50000 THEN '0~5만' WHEN total_spent < 100000 THEN '5~10만' WHEN total_spent < 300000 THEN '10~30만' WHEN total_spent < 500000 THEN '30~50만' WHEN total_spent < 1000000 THEN '50~100만' ELSE '100만 이상' END AS range_label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND total_spent > 0 GROUP BY range_label ) c ON r.range_label = c.range_label ORDER BY r.sort_order

SELECT s.id AS "staffId", s.name AS "staffName", COUNT(r.id) AS "reservationVolume", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN r.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "revenue", ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(r.id), 0), 1 ) AS "completionRate", COALESCE( (SELECT ROUND(AVG(rv.rating), 1) FROM reviews rv WHERE rv.staff_id = s.id AND rv.business_id = #{businessId} AND rv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rv.created_at >= #{startDate}::date AND rv.created_at < (#{endDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') ), 0 ) AS "averageRating", COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN r.total_duration END), 0)::integer AS "averageDuration" FROM staffs s LEFT JOIN reservations r ON s.id = r.staff_id AND r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE s.business_id = #{businessId} AND s.is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY "revenue" DESC

WITH service_data AS ( SELECT (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'id')::bigint AS service_id, jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'name' AS service_name, (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'price')::integer AS service_price FROM reservations r WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.services IS NOT NULL ), service_counts AS ( SELECT service_id, service_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(service_price) AS total_revenue FROM service_data GROUP BY service_id, service_name ) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM service_counts), 0) AS "totalServiceCount", COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT service_id) FROM service_data), 0) AS "uniqueServiceTypes", COALESCE((SELECT AVG(service_price)::bigint FROM service_data), 0) AS "averagePrice", COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.id) FROM service_data sd JOIN services s ON sd.service_id = s.id JOIN service_categories sc ON s.category_id = sc.id), 0 ) AS "categoryCount", (SELECT service_name FROM service_counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) AS "mostPopularService", (SELECT service_name FROM service_counts ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1) AS "mostProfitableService"

WITH service_data AS ( SELECT (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'id')::bigint AS service_id, (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'price')::integer AS service_price FROM reservations r WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.services IS NOT NULL ), total AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(service_price), 1) AS total_revenue FROM service_data ) SELECT COALESCE(sc.id, 0) AS "categoryId", COALESCE(sc.name, '미분류') AS "categoryName", COUNT(DISTINCT sd.service_id) AS "serviceCount", COUNT(*) AS "reservationCount", COALESCE(SUM(sd.service_price), 0) AS "revenue", ROUND(SUM(sd.service_price) * 100.0 / t.total_revenue, 1) AS "percentage" FROM service_data sd LEFT JOIN services s ON sd.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_categories sc ON s.category_id = sc.id CROSS JOIN total t GROUP BY sc.id, sc.name, t.total_revenue ORDER BY "revenue" DESC

WITH service_data AS ( SELECT (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'id')::bigint AS service_id, jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'name' AS service_name, (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'price')::integer AS service_price, r.reservation_date FROM reservations r WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.services IS NOT NULL ), top_services AS ( SELECT service_id, service_name FROM service_data GROUP BY service_id, service_name ORDER BY SUM(service_price) DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT sd.service_id AS "serviceId", sd.service_name AS "serviceName", TO_CHAR(sd.reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS "date", COALESCE(SUM(sd.service_price), 0) AS "revenue", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM service_data sd INNER JOIN top_services ts ON sd.service_id = ts.service_id GROUP BY sd.service_id, sd.service_name, TO_CHAR(sd.reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY sd.service_id, "date" ASC
